working_definition: Author cell type 'photoreceptor-like' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 117 cells): sensory neurons resembling photoreceptors; no author FBbt term (Manual Annotation); no subtype committed.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron that reacts to the presence of light.

justification: Remainder-like call: the authors commit only to the photoreceptor class. FBbt has no native generic 'photoreceptor cell' (only CL:0000210); light-sensitive neuron is the generic FBbt photoreceptor-level cell term and the parent of eye photoreceptor cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Photoreceptor cell of the compound eye.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: More specific than the authors' commitment (location not stated).
